titulo: The form filled out while waiting in line
caption:
The form filled out while waiting in line

The line said now serving five. By the time it said seven, her form was filled in down to the last box.

The minutes in a line are the best time to fill the form, and the desk never waits on you.

For whoever fills in the form before their number is called.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a clock sign that says now: 5 and, below it on the left, a paper form titled No. 7 with four empty boxes. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the four boxes tick one after another while the sign counts up to now: 6 and now: 7, with a small sparkle. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me filling it in while I wait.
